finding.claim: The supplied records contain only two log observations for the window: gateway 'Request completed with HTTP 200' at 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z (incident_1002-E-002) and backend 'Request processing exceeded deadline' at 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z (incident_1002-E-008). The gateway record is a success completion, not an error; the earliest non-success signature is the backend deadline-exceeded message, 14 seconds later. No explicit ERROR/WARN severity signatures appear in the supplied evidence, so the chronology alone shows a downstream symptom on backend after a successful gateway completion and does not establish a causal direction or culprit service.
finding.followup_question: Do any un-supplied records in the same window carry explicit ERROR/WARN severity or error strings for gateway, backend, or any downstream dependency emitted before 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z?

requested_checks.question: For service backend between 2026-10-01T11:59:30Z and 2026-10-01T12:01:00Z, list all log records with severity omitted and no contains filter: did backend emit any error or warning signature earlier than its 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z 'Request processing exceeded deadline' message?
requested_checks.reason: Determines whether the backend deadline signal is the first backend anomaly or is preceded by an earlier backend-origin error signature, which would separate backend-origin failures from downstream dependency failures.
requested_checks.expected_discriminator: Presence of a backend error/warning record strictly before 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z versus only the single deadline-exceeded record at that timestamp.

requested_checks.question: For service gateway between 2026-10-01T11:59:00Z and 2026-10-01T12:00:30Z, list all log records with severity omitted: did gateway emit any error, warning, or non-200 completion before, at, or after the backend deadline message of 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z?
requested_checks.reason: The single gateway observation is an HTTP 200 completion; checking gateway chronology around the backend deadline timestamp establishes whether errors appeared at the gateway edge or whether the gateway stayed healthy while backend degraded.
requested_checks.expected_discriminator: Gateway error/non-200 timestamps relative to 2026-10-01T12:00:14Z: gateway errors at or before the backend deadline indicate edge-origin propagation, whereas gateway staying error-free indicates a backend-side symptom.
